description: A Viam navigation stack wrapping the ROS2 Nav2 and slam_toolbox packages for mapping, localization, and obstacle-aware navigation on any Viam base.

models.short_description: SLAM service wrapping slam_toolbox for mapping and localization on a Viam base.
Motion MoveOnMap (builtin or Nav2) with locations, zones, and go-to DoCommand.
MoveOnMap from any rdk:service:slam; builtin path is ROS-free.
Renders nav costmap, plans, pose, and goal as a live camera image.
Copies a source camera PCD into POSIX shm for low-latency lidar reads.
Slamtec RPLIDAR UART driver that publishes scans to POSIX shm.
